build_shared_mlp: build a SharedMLP module with a list of channel sizes for PointNet2 feature extraction
create_conv2d_layer: create a Conv2d layer with optional batch norm and ReLU activation for 2D convolution
create_conv1d_layer: create a Conv1d layer with optional batch norm and preact mode for 1D convolution
create_conv3d_layer: create a Conv3d layer with optional batch norm and kaiming init for 3D convolution
create_bn_momentum_scheduler: create a BNMomentumScheduler to adjust batch norm momentum per epoch using a lambda function
